description: One server: status (refreshed while an operation is in progress), the last observed machine state (machineState), whether it is billed right now (a STOPPED server is still billed its full hourly rate; a HIBERNATED one its much lower hibernation rate), what keeping it hibernated costs (hibernation: CAD per hour and per month), OS image, public and private IPv4, SSH command, suspension, paid-until date, and its 10 latest activity events (what happened, whether it worked, a short summary and an error code). (permission: servers:read) [Requires a free GPU Cloud account and MCP key]
name: gpucloud_get_server
title: Get a server
